entities.name: Konstantina Kouneva
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Konstantina Kouneva, also known as Kostadinka Kuneva, is a Bulgarian immigrant in Greece, trade unionist and secretary of the Greek Trade Union of Cleaners and Housekeepers. She was elected as an MEP in the 2014 European Parliament elections.
